nights.title: State Champs - moved from Tabernacle
nights.name: State Champs
nights.extract: State Champs is an American pop-punk band from Albany, New York, formed in 2010. They are currently signed to Pure Noise Records and have released three EPs and five full-length albums. Their 2013 debut album The Finer Things debuted at number 2 on the Billboard Heatseekers Albums chart. They released an acoustic EP titled The Acoustic Things in October 2014 and their second studio album Around the World and Back one year later, in October 2015. In May 2017, they released a deluxe version of the album. Their third album, Living Proof, was released in 2018. In May 2022, the band released their fourth studio album, Kings of the New Age. de.who: State Champs ist eine amerikanische Pop-Punk-Band aus Albany, New York, die 2010 gegründet wurde. Die Band ist derzeit bei Pure Noise Records unter Vertrag und hat drei EPs und fünf Alben in voller Länge veröffentlicht.
facts: Das Debütalbum The Finer Things von 2013 debütierte auf Platz 2 der Billboard Heatseekers Albums Charts.
Im November 2024 erschien ihr selbstbetiteltes fünftes Album.

tr.who: State Champs, New York'taki Albany'den çıkan, 2010 yılında kurulmuş bir Amerikan pop-punk grubudur. Grup şu anda Pure Noise Records ile sözleşmeli ve üç EP ile beş tam uzunluklu albüm yayımladı.
facts: The Finer Things adlı 2013 debüt albümü Billboard Heatseekers Albums listesinde 2 numarada giriş yaptı.
Kasım 2024'te grubun kendi adını taşıyan beşinci albümü yayımlandı.

nights.title: Babyfxce E - The Xperience Tour
nights.name: Babyfxce E
nights.extract: Efrem Jamaar Blackwell Jr., known professionally as Babyfxce E, is an American rapper from Flint, Michigan. He gained online traction with his 2022 single "Six Flags," and in 2024, secured a label contract with Atlantic Records. He released his debut album, Da Realest, in February 2026.

en.who: Babyfxce E is an American rapper from Flint, Michigan. the rapper gained online traction with his 2022 single "Six Flags."
facts: in 2024, the rapper secured a label contract with Atlantic Records.
in February 2026, the rapper released the debut album Da Realest.

de.who: Babyfxce E ist ein amerikanischer Rapper aus Flint, Michigan. Der Rapper gewann mit seiner Single „Six Flags“ aus dem Jahr 2022 online an Reichweite.
facts: Im Jahr 2024 sicherte sich der Rapper einen Labelvertrag bei Atlantic Records.
Im Februar 2026 erschien sein Debütalbum Da Realest.

tr.who: Babyfxce E, Michigan eyaletinin Flint kentinden bir Amerikalı rapçidir. Rapçi, 2022 tarihli „Six Flags“ single'ı ile çevrimiçi ilgi kazandı.
facts: 2024 yılında rapçi, Atlantic Records ile bir plak sözleşmesi güvence altına aldı.
Rapçi, debüt albümü Da Realest'i Şubat 2026'da yayımladı.

nights.title: Lil Baby: Fresh Prince of Atlanta Birthday Celebration
nights.name: Lil Baby
nights.extract: Dominique Armani Jones, known professionally as Lil Baby, is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter. He rose to prominence following the release of his 2017 mixtapes Harder than Hard and Too Hard — the former of which spawned his first Billboard Hot 100 entry with its lead single, "My Dawg." He signed with Quality Control Music, an imprint of Motown and Capitol Records to release his debut studio album Harder Than Ever (2018), which peaked at number three on the Billboard 200 and was supported by the Billboard Hot 100-top ten single "Yes Indeed". Later that year, he released the collaborative mixtape Drip Harder with fellow Georgia-based rapper Gunna, and his solo mixtape Street Gossip;

en.who: Lil Baby is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter who rose to prominence following the release of his 2017 mixtapes Harder than Hard and Too Hard. the rapper signed with Quality Control Music, an imprint of Motown and Capitol Records.
facts: his debut studio album Harder Than Ever (2018) peaked at number three on the Billboard 200.
his solo mixtape Street Gossip peaked at number two on the Billboard 200.

de.who: Lil Baby ist ein amerikanischer Rapper, Sänger und Songwriter, der nach der Veröffentlichung seiner Mixtapes Harder than Hard und Too Hard von 2017 bekannt wurde. Der Rapper unterschrieb bei Quality Control Music, einem Imprint von Motown und Capitol Records.
facts: Sein Debütalbum Harder Than Ever (2018) erreichte auf dem Billboard 200 Platz drei.
Sein Solo-Mixtape Street Gossip erreichte auf dem Billboard 200 Platz zwei.

tr.kicker: Amerikalı rapçi, şarkıcı ve söz yazarı
tr.who: Lil Baby, 2017 mixtapeleri Harder than Hard ve Too Hard ile ön plana çıkan bir Amerikalı rapçi, şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Rapçi, Motown ve Capitol Records'un bir imprint'i olan Quality Control Music ile sözleşme imzaladı.
facts: Debüt stüdyo albümü Harder Than Ever (2018) Billboard 200'de üçüncü sıraya yükseldi.
Solo mixtape'i Street Gossip Billboard 200'de ikinci sıraya yükseldi.
